semiconductor_relevance: High — Swadeza Venture Private Limited provides AI-native workflows for semiconductor design and validation, which are critical in the EDA/IP segment.
summary: Swadeza Venture Private Limited offers an on-premises suite of AI-native workflows called FORGE, designed to streamline the semiconductor development process. Their platform integrates various stages of chip design and validation, enhancing efficiency and reducing costs.

regional_presence.India: Swadeza is set to showcase its technology at SEMICON India 2026, indicating a strategic focus on the Indian market.
